Name: Movie Theater Options
Author: Dragoon23
Description:
[size=4][b]Movie Theater Options [/b][/size]
[size=3]
All options are customizable via the config menu or GMCM. 

[b]Options + Notes:[/b][/size]

[size=5][b]Opening/Closing Time & Ticket Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Change Opening/Closing Times.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Change Ticket Price - Requires game restart.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Tickets are not consumed.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Player and NPC Options [/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Unlimited Movies for Player - Player can watch as many movies as they want.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][size=3]1 NPC Date/Day - Can invite 1 NPC per day. Can be the same NPC. Will need to also activate Unlimited Movies for Player.[/size][/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]NPCs always accept Dates - Divorcees, NPCs with no friendship, and Korbus on Friday will accept invites.[/size][/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Max Invited: 1-12 NPCs.  [/size]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Unlimited Dates/Day & Multiple NPCs/Date -
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3][b] [/b]Can invite and take multiple NPCs to the movies at same time. [/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]All NPCs will gain friendship everytime they watch a movie. [/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Concessions still only apply to 1 NPC. [/size][/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Will need to also activate Unlimited Movies for Player and 1 NPC Date/Day.[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Recommended to take 7 or less NPCs. 8+ will have harmless visual bugs and/or harmless console errors. [/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b]Hard Limit of 12 invited NPCs.[/b] More than 12 will cause game to freeze with black screen. With 8+, along with visual bugs, there may [size=3][b][/b][/size]be Smapi errors in the console that says "[game] Event 'MovieTheaterScreening' has command 'warp [NPC Name] X Y' which couldn't be parsed: no NPC found with name '[NPC Name]'." From my testing, this appears to be harmless. To avoid this entirely, follow the recommended soft limit of 7 or less NPCs.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=5][b]Movie Options[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Movie Selection - Choose from the vanilla 8. [/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Movies play Faster - NPCs + Player walk faster to their seats and movie events play faster. [/size][/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3][size=3]Skip Movie Key -[b] This will skip Friendship gains if skipped too early. To keep friendship gains, skip after all invited NPCs' reactions to the movie. [/b][/size][/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b]Crane Game Options[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3]Change Crane Game cost.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Seasonal Prize Selection - Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=3]Remove Crane Man.[/size]
[/list]
[list]
[/list]
[size=3]Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16395?tab=description]Movie Theatre Tweaks[/url]﻿. All code from scratch. [/size]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]﻿to use the config UI.[/size]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works in single player.[/size]
[*][size=3][size=3]Should be compatible with Linux/Mac/Multiplayer but I only test for Windows/single player so can't say for sure.[/size][/size]
[/list]
